description: List suppressed recipients and newsletter opt-outs, newest first. source tells them apart. A suppression (source suppression) has a reason (hard_bounce, complaint, soft_bounce or manual), a scope (all blocks every send; a complaint blocks only its own kind of email: marketing for newsletters, transactional for application senders, mailbox for mail sent from a mailbox) and expires_at (null when permanent; soft-bounce pauses last 30 days). An opt-out (source newsletter_optout, reason unsubscribe, scope marketing) is the reader's own choice, with newsletter_id and test_send; only resubscribing the subscriber lifts it. Filter with reason and scope.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous call.

reason.description: Only entries with this reason. `unsubscribe` lists newsletter opt-outs, the reader's own choice.

scope.description: Only entries with this scope. `all` entries block every send. A complaint blocks only its own kind of email: `marketing` newsletters, `transactional` application senders, `mailbox` mail sent from a mailbox.

name: shipmail_list_suppressions

newsletter_id.description: The newsletter the reader unsubscribed from, when known.

test_send.description: True when the opt-out came from a test send.

title: List Suppressions
